purpose: Non-profit scientific investigation and independently implemented behavioral reconstruction of Cubase for macOS, directed with morluto/rea.

target.selection_reason: Current build on the official download page at study start, broadest edition, matching operation manual, publicly accessible macOS installer.
target.other_architecture_status: Inventory first; x86_64/Rosetta behavior is a separate configuration.
target.edition_note: The official page describes a single installer for all editions; the license selects the running edition. Bundle inspection alone does not verify Pro functionality.
target.acquisition_scope: Complete official installer and native package extraction; full application static signature verification and separate eight VST3 checks complete. No installation or target execution.
target.integrity_evidence: Independent 69-segment and whole-image hashes; native DMG checksum; 49 XAR data checksums and 11 gzip streams; native package signature/notary observation; strict/deep/all-architectures app and eight VST3 verification. No independent fresh online revocation check.

host.limitation: Local macOS 27 is outside the published support list. Runtime observations here do not establish behavior on a supported configuration.

tooling.native_provider_verification_scope: Scoped doctor healthy; synthetic ARM64 controls plus actual Cubase component function dossiers. Retained findings distinguish synthetic readiness from target static evidence; no target execution.
tooling.rea_mcp_registration: Project-local CLI and persistent stdio MCP sessions; no global client registration.

evidence_classes.documented: A primary source says this; not measured in the target.
evidence_classes.static_observation: Exact artifact bytes, structures, instructions, or references, with digest and location.
evidence_classes.runtime_observation: A reproducible action on the identified target/configuration and its retained output.
evidence_classes.inference: A proposed explanation connecting observations; alternatives and disconfirming probes required.
evidence_classes.synthetic_control: An instrument test using our own data or executable; not Cubase evidence.
evidence_classes.candidate_conformance: An independently implemented candidate matches named reference cases under declared criteria.

acceptance.claim_unit: Named observable behavior under a fully identified configuration, stimulus and state history.
acceptance.promotion_rule: Require repeatable reference evidence, independent candidate output, negative controls, held-out compound scenarios and retained failures. Neither decompilation nor harness success establishes Cubase fidelity.

application.platform: Native macOS 14+; SwiftUI/AppKit, AVFoundation, reviewed C processor, ZIPFoundation 0.9.20
application.project_format: Independent .rebaseproj bundle, strict audio-only DAWproject 1.0 subset, and reviewed CPR subset import with unchanged original/report preserved. No CPR writer or complete compatibility.

project open/save and independent Save As
waveform timeline, clip move/end trim/split/delete, and undo/redo
multitrack transport with musical-position display
gain/pan/mute/solo to stereo
jump tempo maps and bar-boundary signature maps
linear or musical track time bases; musical clip starts follow tempo-map edits without stretching audio
bar/beat/quantize snap and grid-relative movement within one signature region
editable read-enabled gain-dB and pan automation with per-point outgoing linear/step interpolation and per-sample application
deterministic stereo float32 WAV export using the shared prepared audio

Bounded CPR clock recovery retains ordered audio tracks, shared native fixed clocks or one/two-point canonical jump maps, and concordant origin meter. Six pinned factory maps recover original period/anchor bits; four fixed results remain unchanged. V1/V2 interpreters and original CPR/report provenance are preserved. Active native descriptors must match exact source replay. Unknown source state remains unsupported; effective hosted clock equivalence is unverified.
Explicit native-to-application timing conversion retains musical anchors; untouched signature edits retain native timing. Persistence binds active clock provenance to the replayed preserved source.
Source-backed unresolved CPR audio events, bounded saved LoFi placement, explicit unplaced Classic event, shared object caches, source-replay provenance, Undo/Redo and playback/export barriers.

Explicit source-bound PCM attachment/replacement with whole-shared-file interval validation, transactional cleanup, SHA custody, Undo/Redo and package persistence; integer segment mapping integrated into actual-media validation.

Explicit source-event research rendering replays frozen CPR provenance and reconstructs one supported zero-origin event from user-selected matching mono/stereo PCM24 WAV, at the original rate, to Float32 WAV with a separate event-gain multiply. Fresh source state, no external pitch context, empty event processing state, supported hitpoint children, absent warp/inversion/explicit fades and source-effective automatic-fade flags zero are required. The event remains unresolved for ordinary project playback, mixdown and exchange; no frozen import profile or original/report is rewritten.
Fresh source-audio inspection decodes project/track automatic-fade settings, displays source gain/inversion/fade/warp state and uses a source-bound asynchronous save flow.

A checked native-derived rate-request budget kernel evaluates explicit conditional arithmetic, including initial mode-2 allowance, against 244 pinned analytical vectors and independent controls. It neither selects/certifies an available backend nor generates resampled samples.

Explicit source-preserving stereo event audition reuses verified source PCM at its saved rate, with Play/Pause/seek/end handling, a persistent event-only label and Exit action. Every resume/seek rereads source/report/media proof; project edits, replacement, attachment changes, Undo/Redo and changed selection end the mode. Project mixer, routing, effects and automation are bypassed. The unresolved event and frozen profiles remain unchanged; ordinary project playback, mixdown and exchange retain their barriers.

A bounded unit-agnostic reconstruction of native segment selection retains generation/successor behavior and inclusive endpoint comparison. Source audition supplies a separately justified zero-origin source descriptor; it does not infer arbitrary native builder units. Application scheduling uses its own half-open sample intervals and nearest-frame, ties-away-from-zero quantization. Device scheduling, unity routing and completion via AVAudioPlayerNode dataPlayedBack callbacks are application implementation, not measured Cubase host behavior.

Explicit native mode0 Float32 stereo upsampling is available for supported source-event audition at a higher integral project rate from 8–192 kHz. The source-rate path remains the default. Exact Float32 rates are widened for the binary64 step; sample production retains native phase/history, separately rounded terms and fused multiply-add before a single Float32 store. Event gain follows conversion as a separate Float32 multiplication. Reset consumes the first input as history and EOF emits no invented tail; the LoFi control produces 1,151,999 frames at 48 kHz from 1,058,400 frames at 44.1 kHz.

Recovered stereo ring producer/consumer value operations transfer interleaved samples to two 32768-frame planes without gain. Application admission replaces native polling with transactional WOULD_BLOCK; the adapter writes and consumes at most 8192 output frames per transfer, including converter blocks larger than the ring. Normal underrun holds the native-style timeline, draining underrun copies a prefix and pads, and stopped output pads without consuming. The application uses only the sufficient-data branch for prepared output transfer.

The complete source is freshly proof-checked and decoded into immutable resident PCM. Converted output is generated in stateful 8192-input blocks and scheduled through a four-buffer AVAudioEngine queue. Seek resets the converter and discards preroll from source zero, preserving the crossing-block suffix. Queue depth, serialized transfer, reset/preroll seeks, frame quantization and device delivery are explicit application policies, not a recovered full Cubase callback graph. Main-actor refill can underrun during UI stalls; resident input and bounded converted output are not disk streaming or a hard-real-time guarantee.
remaining_scope: audio/MIDI recording and automation writing modes
VST hosting, live multichannel inserts, groups and sends
tempo ramps, time stretch, swing/grooves and broader timing semantics
Full CPR event/media/MIDI/mixer/plugin/map compatibility and writing; broader DAWproject semantics/runtime interoperability

Other differing-rate sample conversion modes, downsampling and backend/default/lifecycle selection
complete Cubase UI and behavioral fidelity
application.playback_edit_limitation: Ordinary prepared clips rebuild on edits. Source-event mode exits on edits; native mode0 audition retains immutable source input and a bounded converted queue. Preparation/preroll/refill on the main actor and AVAudioEngine delivery do not establish native scheduling or hard-real-time behavior.
application.save_policy: Named projects save explicitly; unsaved New/Open/Quit guarded; scratch sessions keep recovery copy. Save As creates independent package without writing original.
application.meter: Actual engine stereo output buffer peaks; no DAC measurement
application.tempo_status: General application jump tempo/signature maps, anchors and snapping remain application policies. CPR fixed-v1 and jump-map-v1 clocks separately retain recovered native arithmetic with480ticks perquarter, bounded finite normal-or-zero domain and nearest rounding. Map records preserve direct binary32 periods; one/two kind0 records require positive-zero origin and exact canonical cached anchors. Default local lifecycle is bounded; replaceable host providers/observers remain unverified. More points, ramps and broader signature/display/stretch/swing semantics remain unresolved.
application.automation_status: Editable read gainDB/pan lanes evaluate at absolute project sample time. Gain interpolation is in dB, pan in bipolar value space; outgoing point interpolation is linear or step. No Touch/AutoLatch/Overwrite recording state machine or native interpolation equivalence is claimed.
application.exchange_status: Strict DAWproject 1.0 audio subset with transactional import/export and referenced-media extraction. Unsupported routing/devices, musical anchors, ramps, missing interpolation and unrepresented automation reject. An active native clock requires explicit Use Rebase Timing conversion before exchange; it is never silently serialized as generic BPM math. Local roundtrips/XSD checks are not Cubase runtime interoperability.
application.ambisonic_status: Standalone IEEE-float WAV conversion for 4/9/16 channels and both precisions/directions. Float64 storage is preserved; the reviewed processor has explicit sample/FP/state restrictions. No live insert, VST host ABI, or target runtime parity is established.

Ring controls cover FIFO wrap, capacity, zero/stop/drain/underrun and transactional rejection. Initial full-suite compilation failed on a Swift test expression and is retained; it was corrected before the passing runs. Eight final-binary native GUI groups passed with independent retained-state/hash review and ten unchanged package files. These are analytical/application checks with zero Cubase runtime comparisons; physical-output and whole-product fidelity remain unestablished.

validation_history.gui_validation_status: Ten native GUI groups passed: frozen V4 open, rejection/attachment/replacement, Undo/Redo, removal, save/reopen, Save As, playback/mixdown barriers and changed-PCM rejection.

validation_history.build_status: 0.8.0 build8 release completed with strict local code-signature verification. Final asynchronous Open correction and subsequent source export were exercised on the final binary; source/sample/custody checks are retained in APP008.
validation_history.gui_validation_status: Five bounded native Rebase GUI groups passed: Open/cancel, source inspection, source rendering, source-render Cancel/reopen with Save enabled, and ordinary project-playback refusal. The earlier runModal Open stalled under computer automation and initial export QA used --project. After asynchronous Open correction, the final binary opened the copied package, canceled/reopened Open and repeated the source export successfully. Not every group was rerun on the last binary; only the Open method changed after the earlier successful source-render GUI checks. Broader Open/document workflows are not comprehensively reaccepted.

validation_history.build_status: 0.9.0 build9 release built and fingerprinted at 4,775,808 bytes; final source manifest covers 76 files. After the shared diagnostic wording and edit-exit status corrections, the release suite and all seven GUI groups were repeated on the accepted executable. Final source/bundle snapshots are retained in APP009.
validation_history.gui_validation_status: Seven final-binary native Rebase GUI groups passed: Open/inspect; play/pause/seek/resume/natural end; restart/return/stop/past-end bounds; changed-media rejection/restoration; full-project play/mix barriers; edit/Undo exits; and explicit Exit Audition. An independent read of retained accessibility snapshots plus fresh executable/package hashes supports all seven outcomes and five unchanged package files. All seven groups were repeated after the diagnostic and stale edit-exit footer corrections. This is not an independently replayed GUI history, captured device output or Cubase runtime comparison.
